mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a dog bite attorney?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most dangerous dog injury attorneys, including those at the Law Office of Brett Peterson, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront fees or hourly rates. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the final settlement or court award you receive. If your case is unsuccessful, you typically owe no attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without financial burden during a difficult time.
